About me

I design complex products so they feel simple, and I make sure they ship that way.

I'm Francisca, a Senior Product Designer based in Santiago, Chile, with 6+ years designing B2B SaaS, fintech and enterprise software for Front, Banco Bci, ETpay and Racional.

I lead end to end design from discovery to shipped UI, tying every decision to business KPIs. I also close the gap between the design system and production by shipping fixes through my own PRs, using Claude Code, Storybook and GitHub.

Before Front, I led a team of 4 designers at ETpay. Today I also co lead Friends of Figma Chile, the official local Figma community.
